children: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 26, 2026) - Allegiance Resources Corp.
") is pleased to announce the appointment of Jarrett Berezan as Chief Executive Officer of the Company, effective immediately.

The Company also announces the appointment of Nicky Mei to the Company's Board of Directors as well as the resignation of Kelly Abbott as Chief Executive Officer and a director of the Company, both effective immediately.

Mr. Berezan brings 20 years of experience in mining and power generation industry. He began his career as a mine engineer and went on to lead mine production and power plant operations, helping guide the workforce through the transition from coal to natural gas. More recently, ha has helped prepare a major underground potash mine and its workforce for production. He holds a bachelor's and master's degree in mining engineering from the University of Alberta.

Mr. Mei is a Vancouver-based corporate development and capital markets consultant with nearly a decade of experience in financial services, including financial planning at a major Canadian institution. Nicky supports founders and early-stage companies with capital-raising readiness, investor communications and the development of compliant systems, helping them prepare for investment and build stronger foundations for growth.
On behalf of the Board of Directors, the Company extends a warm welcome to Mr. Jarrett Berezan and Mr. Nicky Mei and looks forward to working with both in this new chapter for the Company.
The Company thanks Mr. Abott for his contributions and service and wishes him well in his future endeavours.

(FSE: BG5), formerly Pegmatite One Lithium and Gold Corp., is a Canadian mineral exploration company focused on tungsten and other critical metals in established mining jurisdictions. The Company holds a 100% interest in the Thanksgiving, Five T's and Rio Grande tungsten projects in British Columbia and, through its wholly owned U.S. subsidiary, Wolfram Critical Minerals Inc., the Golden Scheelite Tungsten Project in Humboldt County, Nevada.
